recent_articles.title: West Asia crisis hurting Indian tea exporters - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Indian Tea Association (ITA)** officials reported that the West Asia conflict has significantly impacted tea exports, with 87% of India's total exports concentrated in countries around the Gulf of Persia and the Gulf of Oman. The conflict, which began in February, has led to declining export volumes between January and March compared to 2025, as well as increased freight rates and shipping costs. **Dinesh Bihani**, secretary of the Guwahati Tea Auction Buyers’ Association, stated that the economic uncertainty in West Asia is causing importers to be cautious about buying tea, leading to softer demand and price pressure on both domestic and international markets.  The industry remains hopeful for a recovery in trade flows and consumption once stability returns.

recent_articles.title: Bangladesh-China talks underway for Tarique Rahman’s first foreign visit - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tarique Rahman**, Bangladesh's new Prime Minister, is in talks with **China** to visit the country in late June.  The **Chinese** government is keen on welcoming him for his first foreign trip since taking office in February. The planned visit will include high-level meetings between **Rahman** and top Chinese leaders, including President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Li Keqiang.

recent_articles.title: Man arrested for murdering woman, dumping body in Tirupalya lake in Anekal taluk - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ratan Das**, a man from Assam, was arrested in connection with the murder of a 47-year-old woman whose body was found floating in **Tirupalya Lake** in Anekal taluk.  Police confirmed that the woman had been strangled and suffocated before being disposed of in thick grass near the lake. The investigation revealed that **Das** had an illicit relationship with the victim and confessed to killing her after pressure to marry. He is currently under judicial custody.

recent_articles.title: Will lead to further inflation, growth estimates will be lowered considerably: Congress on fuel hike - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** criticized the **Modi government** for increasing petrol and diesel prices, claiming it will exacerbate inflation and lower growth estimates. The party's general secretary, **Jairam Ramesh**, stated that despite falling international oil prices for years, domestic prices remained high, leading to consumer exploitation.  Fuel prices were hiked by ₹3 per litre each on Friday (May 15, 2026), marking the first increase in over four years and coming after a period of price freezes. The hike was attributed to rising global crude prices triggered by the West Asia conflict and is expected to impact inflation and growth estimates.

recent_articles.title: Assam ships first legal agarwood chips to West Asia - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam** marked a significant milestone in its agro-forest economy by exporting the first legally approved consignment of agarwood chips to **Saudi Arabia** and the **UAE**. The shipment, valued at ₹2.35 crore, was flagged off by **Jehirul Islam**, chairman of the All Assam Agarwood Planters and Traders’ Association, after securing all necessary permits including a CITES permit and a restricted export license from the Directorate General of Foreign Trade.  **Dr. Islam** expressed gratitude to **Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma** for supporting the Assam Agarwood Promotion Policy, 2020, which aims to regulate agarwood cultivation, processing, and exports. The policy is expected to curb illegal trade and generate substantial revenue for the state.

recent_articles.title: Modi cuts motorcade size to save fuel amid mounting economic pressure - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Narendra Modi**, the Indian Prime Minister, has significantly reduced the size of his motorcade to save fuel in response to soaring energy prices triggered by the Iran war.  Following a public appeal for austerity measures, including reducing foreign travel and oil consumption, **Modi** scaled down motorcades for visits to Gujarat and Assam, while also requesting electric vehicles be included where possible. The government source declined to specify the exact size of the reduced motorcade but confirmed essential security components were maintained in line with protocol.

recent_articles.title: Assam filmmaker’s documentary screened at British Film Institute in London - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chalo India with Ericji (Varanasi)**, a documentary by Assam filmmaker Rajdeep Choudhury, was screened at the British Film Institute in London. The film, part of a larger travel and cultural anthology presented by former UK MP **Eric Ollerenshaw**, explores Varanasi's culture, history, and everyday life during Makar Sankranti.  The screening was organized by the High Commission of India, London, in collaboration with the U.K. Asian Film Festival and Tongues on Fire. The documentary team received the Heritage Cinema Excellence Award for their contributions to cultural storytelling through cinema.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Election results 2026: Why welfare policies aren't winning polls in India like it used to
recent_articles.rephrased_article: India's welfare politics, once a key electoral tool, is facing challenges. While cash transfers and subsidized services have become the norm across parties, recent state elections suggest that extensive welfare delivery alone is no longer enough to secure incumbency.  **Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress**, for example, lost power in West Bengal despite its women-centric welfare schemes. **The Bharatiya Janata Party** has capitalized on expanding welfare architecture, including women's self-help groups and administrative efficiency, while voters are increasingly demanding more than just welfare benefits.  Political scientists argue that this shift signifies a move from the floor of Indian politics to the ceiling, where parties must build coalitions around broader issues like job creation and economic mobility.

recent_articles.title: BJP MLA Tapas Roy sworn in as Pro-tem Speaker of West Bengal Assembly - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tapas Roy**, a senior Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader and MLA from Maniktala, was sworn in as the Pro-Tem Speaker of the West Bengal Assembly on Tuesday, May 12, 2026. **Suvendu Adhikari**, the Chief Minister, attended the ceremony. The oath-taking of other MLAs will be held on Wednesday and Thursday, with the election for Speaker scheduled for Friday.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: CM is unsettled by PM’s remarks: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** in Karnataka responded to **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah's** criticism of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, stating that the Prime Minister's speech at a BJP event was within his democratic right. The opposition leader, R. Ashok, argued that the Prime Minister spoke about issues affecting 7 crore Kannadigas and that Siddaramaiah should focus on addressing real concerns in Karnataka rather than being rattled by the remarks.

recent_articles.title: Farmers take out rally demanding legal guarantee for MSP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Scores** of farmers from across **Andhra Pradesh**, **Assam**, and other states participated in a rally organized by the **Akhila Bharata Aikya Rythu Sangham (AIUKS)** in Yellandu, Bhadradri Kothagudem district. The rally demanded a legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price (MSP) and implementation of the C2 + 50% formula.  **AIUKS** leaders, including **Pradeep Singh Tagore**, **Kechela Ranga Reddy**, and **Potu Ranga Rao**, led the demonstration, which culminated in a public meeting.

recent_articles.title: NDA leaders stake claim to form Assam government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**-led **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was unanimously elected as the leader of the Assam Legislature Party.  Following this, the NDA staked a claim to form the government in Assam with the support of 102 MLAs. The swearing-in ceremony for the new council of ministers is scheduled for May 12th. **J.P. Nadda**, Union Minister and central observer for the BJP Legislature Party meeting, announced that eight BJP legislators proposed Sarma's name as their leader.  The newly elected members of the BJP and its regional allies — **Asom Gana Parishad (AGP)** and **Bodoland People’s Front (BPF)** — chose their leaders in the morning.

recent_articles.title: Labour shortage stalls Mananchira-Vellimadukunnu Road widening works - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Road Fund Board** officials cite a labor shortage caused by migrant workers from West Bengal and Assam returning home for the Assembly elections as a major obstacle to widening the Mananchira-Vellimadukunnu Road in Kozhikode. The scarcity of bitumen, also impacting construction progress, has further delayed the project. While some workers have returned, the issue of bitumen supply remains unresolved.

recent_articles.title: Critically endangered gharial spotted in Assam's Kaziranga after years - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Chief Minister’s Office (CMO)** of Assam announced that a critically endangered gharial has been sighted in Kaziranga National Park. The reptile, previously believed to have disappeared from the state's river systems, is now considered a success story for wildlife conservation efforts in Assam.

recent_articles.title: Which party governs which State/UT: In maps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and its allies secured victories in Assam, Puducherry, and West Bengal, while the Congress-led UDF won in Tamil Nadu. **Suvendu Adhikari**, a BJP leader, is set to become the first BJP Chief Minister of West Bengal. The results mark a shift in the political landscape with the BJP or the NDA now governing 20 states and 2 Union Territories.
